sections.title: Mental model
sections.body:
Two themes:

- **Routing** — React Router v6+ uses data routers (`loader` / `action`); Next.js App Router has   layouts + server components.
- **Forms** — controlled inputs are simple but expensive at scale; React Hook Form (uncontrolled   + refs) wins on performance.

Validation lives in **Zod / Yup** with React Hook Form; share schemas with the backend if you can.

sections.title: Must-know concepts
sections.body:
The interview surface for this module breaks into these focus areas:

- **React router basics** — drill the named patterns, the failure modes, and the recommended Java / framework idiom.
- **Nested routes and layouts** — drill the named patterns, the failure modes, and the recommended Java / framework idiom.
- **Route guards and loaders** — drill the named patterns, the failure modes, and the recommended Java / framework idiom.
- **Forms controlled vs uncontrolled** — drill the named patterns, the failure modes, and the recommended Java / framework idiom.
- **React hook form** — drill the named patterns, the failure modes, and the recommended Java / framework idiom.
- **Formik and yup** — drill the named patterns, the failure modes, and the recommended Java / framework idiom.
- **Validation with zod** — drill the named patterns, the failure modes, and the recommended Java / framework idiom.
- **File upload handling** — drill the named patterns, the failure modes, and the recommended Java / framework idiom.
- **Scenario-based** — applied questions tying multiple topics together. Drill these *last*, after the fundamentals are sharp.

sections.title: Likely interview hooks
sections.body:
- **Nested routes** — index routes + outlet; layouts in App Router.
- **Protected routes** — redirect from `loader`; never block in render.
- **Server-side validation** is the source of truth; client is UX sugar.
- **Optimistic UI** for forms — show success, rollback on error.
- **Accessibility** — labels, fieldset/legend, error association.

sections.title: Speaking template
sections.body: > *"I'd use React Hook Form + Zod for the form, lift validation rules into a shared schema, submit through a route action, optimistic-update the UI, and ensure every field has an associated label + announced error."*
